title: Virulence on Pm4 kinase-based resistance is determined by two divergent wheat powdery mildew effectors
authors: Bernasconi Z; Herger AG; Caro MDP; Kunz L; Müller MC; Stirnemann U; Outram MA; Widrig V; Neidhart M; Isaksson J; Schudel S; Rösli S; Wicker T; Bender KW; Zipfel C; Dodds PN; Figueroa M; Sánchez-Martín J; Keller B
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小麦白粉病菌效应蛋白与植物免疫受体Pm4的互作，属于植物-病原菌蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The wheat resistance gene Pm4 encodes a kinase fusion protein and has gained particular attention as it confers race-specific resistance against two major wheat pathogens: powdery mildew and blast. Here, we describe the identification of AvrPm4, the mildew avirulence effector recognised by Pm4, using UV- mutagenesis, and its functional validation in wheat protoplasts. We show that AvrPm4 directly interacts with and is phosphorylated by Pm4. Using genetic association and QTL mapping, we furthermore demonstrate that evasion of Pm4 resistance by virulent mildew isolates relies on a second fungal component, SvrPm4 , which suppresses AvrPm4 -induced cell death. Surprisingly, SvrPm4 was previously described as AvrPm1a . We show that SvrPm4, but not its inactive variant svrPm4, is recognised by the NLR immune receptor Pm1a. These multiple roles of a single effector provide a new perspective on fungal (a)virulence proteins and their combinatorial interactions with different types of immune receptors.
abstract_zh: 小麦抗性基因Pm4编码一种激酶融合蛋白，并因其对两种主要小麦病原体——白粉病和稻瘟病——提供小种特异性抗性而受到特别关注。在此，我们描述了通过UV诱变鉴定AvrPm4（即被Pm4识别的白粉病无毒效应子）的过程，及其在小麦原生质体中的功能验证。我们表明，AvrPm4与Pm4直接相互作用并被其磷酸化。利用遗传关联分析和QTL定位，我们进一步证明，毒性白粉病菌株逃避Pm4抗性依赖于第二个真菌组分SvrPm4，该组分抑制AvrPm4诱导的细胞死亡。令人惊讶的是，SvrPm4此前被描述为AvrPm1a。我们表明，SvrPm4（而非其非活性变体svrPm4）被NLR免疫受体Pm1a识别。单一效应子的这些多重角色为真菌（无）毒力蛋白及其与不同类型免疫受体的组合互作提供了新视角。
